lyrics:
[Intro: disco guitar, handclaps, a party popper]

[Verse 1: first voice, bright and bouncy]
Pyjama top and a paper crown
The weekend's cancelled and the blinds are down
So I made a disco from the kitchen light
And I'm headlining here tonight

[Pre-Chorus: second voice, falsetto, bass walks up]
Don't need a ticket, don't need a queue
Got a hairbrush and a view

[Chorus: whole group, horns, claps on every beat]
Throw confetti in the living room
We don't need a reason, we don't need a tune
Torn-up bills and a magazine
Make it rain like a movie scene
Da-na-na, na-na-na, hey
Small room, big day
Da-na-na, na-na-na, hey
Confetti in the living room

[Verse 2: third voice, half rapped, playful]
Neighbour banged the wall so I banged it back in time
Now she's in the doorway with a tambourine and wine
Cat's on the speaker, dog's on the chair
Everybody's welcome, there's a spare

[Pre-Chorus: second voice, falsetto, bass walks up]
Don't need a ticket, don't need a queue
Got a hairbrush and a view

[Chorus: whole group, horns, claps on every beat]
Throw confetti in the living room
We don't need a reason, we don't need a tune
Torn-up bills and a magazine
Make it rain like a movie scene
Da-na-na, na-na-na, hey
Small room, big day
Da-na-na, na-na-na, hey
Confetti in the living room

[Bridge: breakdown, bass and claps, voices trading]
Sweep it up tomorrow
(Tomorrow)
Sweep it up tomorrow
Tonight we throw

[Final Chorus: key up a step, everyone, horn runs]
Throw confetti in the living room
We don't need a reason, we don't need a tune
Torn-up bills and a magazine
Make it rain like a movie scene
Da-na-na, na-na-na, hey
Small room, big day
Da-na-na, na-na-na, hey
Confetti in the living room

[Outro: claps, a party popper, laughter]
Hey
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 114 BPM, 4/4, E major, stepping up a key for the last chorus. Bright, bouncy and carefree disco-pop.

VOICE: A group of young men with distinct voices: a bright, clean lead, a sweet high falsetto, and a playful half-rapped verse. The choruses are sung by all of them in unison and harmony, ending on a chant of 'da-na-na' syllables.

INSTRUMENTS: A funky, clean disco guitar. A slap-style bass with a bounce. A live-sounding disco drum kit with open hi-hats. A horn section with short, joyful stabs and runs. Handclaps on every beat of the chorus. Electric piano. A string pad. Party poppers and a tambourine.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar, claps and a party popper. 0:09 Verse 1. 0:26 Pre-chorus. 0:35 Chorus 1. 1:08 Verse 2. 1:25 Pre-chorus. 1:34 Chorus 2. 2:07 Bridge, bass and claps. 2:24 The key lifts for the final chorus with horn runs. 2:57 Outro, claps, a popper and laughter at 3:10.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s retro disco-pop: glossy, bright and tight, horns and vocals shining, a punchy clean low end.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The 'da-na-na' chant at the end of the first chorus.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The neighbour bangs on the wall and then comes round with a tambourine. Anyone who lived through 2020 as an adult knows this room, and the song remembers it kindly.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Boredom defeated, company arriving, pure fun.
